svg.text: Step 6: Leads from the RJ12 boards (18)
Top side. Each lead goes in from the top. Pin 1 is the square pad on each RJ12 board.
You need: 3 × RJ12 breakout board, 6 × 22 AWG stranded insulated wire, 5–8 cm (battery + and GND), 12 × 30 AWG silicone stranded wire, 5–8 cm (signals)
Let the RJ12 boards hang off the end and tape them down while you work underneath.
